summary: The OccHealthCovid19EditAll module manages and edits occupational health COVID-19 immunization records for students in an enrollment grid. It supports bulk and individual editing, validation, workflow navigation, and integrates with session and status code lists.
purpose: To provide a user control/UI for administrators or authorized users to view, edit, and update COVID-19 immunization details for students within an occupational health context, including status codes and administration dates, by cohort, term, course, and other filters.

workflows.name: Edit COVID-19 Immunization Records (Bulk or Individual)
steps: Load gridDataEdit with student records filtered by Cohort, Term, Course, etc.
Bind COVID-19 status codes to dropdown fields for each student row.
If blnReadOnly is true, disable edit fields and calendars.
User edits status codes and administration dates in grid.
Dirty flag (txtDirty) tracks modified records via JavaScript function setDirty(rowIndex).
User can Save (single row) or Save All/Edit Next (multiple rows).
On Save/Save All/Save Edit Next, backend updates immunization records for each dirty student row using StudentPrerequisites.StudentDetailsImmunizationOccHealthCovid19Update.
System checks for warnings; if none, redirects appropriately (EnrollmentEditAll.aspx or Enrollment.aspx).
Buttons and UI controls adjust visibility based on EnrollmentID and grid row counts (Save, Save All, Edit Next, Cancel).

workflows.name: Validation and Data Binding
steps: ValidationSummary1 control summarizes any validation errors.
dsCRC ObjectDataSource binds filtered list to gridDataEdit.
Covid19StatusCodeList is loaded using Codes.CodeSearch for 'FluImmunizations'.
gridDataEdit_RowDataBound binds each row, sets dropdown values, disables calendar if read-only.

business_rules: Only dirty rows (marked by txtDirty) are updated during Save/Save All.
Read-only mode disables all edit fields and date pickers.
If EnrollmentID != 0, single edit mode; disables Save All button.
If gridDataEdit.Rows < 14, header Save All and Cancel buttons are hidden (prevents scroll bars).
Covid19StatusCode dropdown must reflect accurate code for each student row.
ShowGrad, ShowInactive, ShowWaived, and other flags must filter/enrich display and update logic.
validations: UserSession must be present for data selection; otherwise, dsCRC_Selecting cancels operation.
Covid19StatusCode must be present for each student row.
Admin dates (Covid19AdminDate, Covid19AdminDate2, Covid19AdminDate3) are input fields and could have date format/logic validation.
calculations: StartRow + gridDataEdit.PageSize computes next page navigation in query string.
DropdownChangeCovid19Status combines row index and selected index for JavaScript invocation.
conditions: If EnrollmentID > 0, single edit mode; show only Save button.
If EnrollmentID == 0, batch edit mode; show Save All and Edit Next controls.
Hide Save All and Cancel buttons if gridDataEdit.Rows < 14.
If gridDataEdit.Rows.Count < gridDataEdit.PageSize, hide Edit Next controls.
If blnReadOnly, disable calendar and all edit fields.
system_behavior: SetupJavaScript prepares dirty tracking and status change functions for client-side use.
After saving, redirects are performed only if UserSession.Messages.GetWarnings() is empty.
Grid.HideButtons adjusts button visibility based on mode and row count.
Dropdowns and calendars manipulated based on read-only mode and context.
dependencies: UserSession for permission, session logic, warnings
exceptions: If UserSession is null, dsCRC_Selecting cancels operation.
If warnings are present after saving, redirect is skipped.
content_gaps: No explicit business logic for date validation or error handling on update failures.
No list of all possible Covid19StatusCodes, only reference to Codes.CodeSearch.
No details on how warnings are generated or their exact content.
Some UI layout and rendering mechanisms (e.g. how calendar controls are visually disabled) are not fully described.
No sample values or usage for fields like keyword, CommentFilter.
Exception handling and user messaging not fully detailed.
